exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

effects.target_preference: any valid enemy not in the memory set
effects.all_targets_marked_fallback: selects normally rather than withholding fire

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: converts repeated single-target fire into broad crowd suppression

rules.text: The weapon remembers enemies it hit during the previous 1.5 s and prefers any valid enemy not in that memory set.
Every hit slows its target by 25% for 1.0 s. Bosses receive the globally resisted form.
If every valid target is already marked, it selects normally rather than withholding fire.
Damage is unchanged; the branch converts repeated single-target fire into broad crowd suppression.
